entry.title: AutoMapper/AutoMapper - Releases - 2026-11-05
entry.content:
v15.1.4

Security

This release fixes two denial-of-service vulnerabilities. In both, deeply nested input could bypass MaxDepth and exhaust the stack. The resulting StackOverflowException can't be caught, so it ends the process. Please upgrade if your application maps untrusted, deeply nested data.

  • GHSA-6vhm-j9h7-f9gh: MaxDepth wasn't enforced when mapping through constructor parameters, including positional records. Thanks to @mcambria for the report.
  • GHSA-gpwp-5797-mjff: other recursion paths bypassed MaxDepth: derived maps, object and interface members, dictionary and dynamic sources, and recursive type converters.

CVE IDs have been requested and will be added here once they're assigned.

Behavior changes

  • Recursion that MaxDepth can't limit now throws a catchable InsufficientExecutionStackException instead of crashing the process.
  • Derived maps (Include / IncludeBase) now inherit MaxDepth and get the default limit of 64 for self-referential maps. If your polymorphic graphs legitimately go deeper, set MaxDepth explicitly.
  • Constructor mapping now stops at the same depth as property mapping.

Other fixes

  • Fixed Context.Items are only available... exceptions with MaxDepth, which depended on registration or warmup order (#4651, backported in #4676)

What's Changed

  • [15.x] Fail the release when the tag is not on its release branch by @jbogard in #4669
  • [15.x] Emit the context check for the containing type map in CollectionMapper by @jbogard in #4676
  • [15.x] Run unit tests on .NET Framework in CI by @jbogard in #4678

Full Changelog: v15.1.3...v15.1.4

v16.3.0

Security

This release fixes two denial-of-service vulnerabilities. In both, deeply nested input could bypass MaxDepth and exhaust the stack. The resulting StackOverflowException can't be caught, so it ends the process. Please upgrade if your application maps untrusted, deeply nested data.

  • GHSA-6vhm-j9h7-f9gh: MaxDepth wasn't enforced when mapping through constructor parameters, including positional records. Thanks to @mcambria for the report.
  • GHSA-gpwp-5797-mjff: other recursion paths bypassed MaxDepth: derived maps, object and interface members, dictionary and dynamic sources, and recursive type converters.

CVE IDs have been requested and will be added here once they're assigned.

Behavior changes

  • Recursion that MaxDepth can't limit now throws a catchable InsufficientExecutionStackException instead of crashing the process.
  • Derived maps (Include / IncludeBase) now inherit MaxDepth and get the default limit of 64 for self-referential maps. If your polymorphic graphs legitimately go deeper, set MaxDepth explicitly.
  • Constructor mapping now stops at the same depth as property mapping.
  • Condition on ForAllMembers, or any condition whose member parameter is object or a base type, now receives the source member value instead of the value converted to the destination type, when those types differ. This matches the documented contract. A null in a nullable source member is now seen as null rather than 0 or false (#4655).

Other highlights

  • Fixed Context.Items are only available... exceptions with MaxDepth, which depended on registration or warmup order (#4651)

  • License keys get a 30-day renewal grace period, which logs a warning instead of an error (#4667)

  • Clearer license validation messages for malformed keys, client platforms and IdentityModel version mismatches (#4670)

  • Whitespace is stripped from license keys (#4663), and license validation is isolated from the host app's CryptoProviderFactory (#4674)

  • What's Changed

  • Bump Testcontainers.MsSql to 4.14.0 to clear NU1903 by @jbogard in #4652
  • docs: replace dead MyGet build link with CI feed link by @JiuYue0820 in #4648
  • Emit the context check for the containing type map in CollectionMapper (fixes #4650) by @jbogard in #4651
  • Pass the source member value to Condition by @jbogard in #4655
  • Fix licensing page structure in docs ToC by @jbogard in #4664
  • Fix BuildDateUtc embedding on Windows builds by @jbogard in #4666
  • License validation: WARNING during the renewal grace period by @jbogard in #4667
  • Fail the release when the tag is not on its release branch by @jbogard in #4668
  • ci: bump lock-threads to v6 to fix token validation failure by @simpleqt in #4658
  • Strip whitespace from license keys before resolving precedence by @AVTUNEY in #4663
  • License validation: clear messages for malformed keys, client platforms, and IdentityModel version mismatches by @jbogard in #4670
  • Move to central package management by @jbogard in #4672
  • License validation: isolate from the host app's CryptoProviderFactory by @jbogard in #4674
  • Replace broken ApiCompat setup with SDK package validation by @jbogard in #4673
  • Add regression test for registration-order MaxDepth context failure by @jbogard in #4675
  • Document license key environment variables in the README by @jbogard in #4677

New Contributors

  • @JiuYue0820 made their first contribution in #4648
  • @simpleqt made their first contribution in #4658
  • @AVTUNEY made their first contribution in #4663

Full Changelog: v16.2.0...v16.3.0

entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-11-05
entry.content:
4.0.364.0

4.0.364.0 (2026-11-05 19:17 UTC)

  • AccountAccessRuntime (4.0.100.0)
    • Adds SDK support for Account Access user portal operations, enabling users to list out and get credentials for role assignments configured in AWS IAM Account Access Manager.
  • AgentRegistryControl (4.0.104.0)
    • Adds support for OAuth2 Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414) discovery URLs in custom JWT authorizer.
  • AppIntegrationsService (4.0.104.0)
    • This release adds a LastModifiedRegion field to GetApplication and ListApplications so customers can see which Region an application was last modified in.
  • BedrockAgentCoreControl (4.0.126.0)
    • Adds support for OAuth2 Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414) discovery URLs in custom JWT authorizer and OAuth2 credential provider configurations.
  • BedrockAgentRuntime (4.0.106.0)
    • Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports an optional mediaId parameter in GetDocumentContent that you can use to retrieve images embedded in source documents.
  • CloudWatchLogs (4.0.108.0)
    • Adds account-level retention policies with dry run preview and the Essentials log group class to Amazon CloudWatch Logs
  • DataSync (4.0.102.0)
    • Adds support for federated identity on Azure Blob Storage and object storage locations, enabling DataSync to authenticate to Azure and Google Cloud Storage using Workload Identity Federation (WIF) over OpenID Connect (OIDC) instead of stored long-lived credentials.
  • Glue (4.0.117.0)
    • AWS Glue Spark ETL jobs can now auto-upgrade to the latest version. Set GlueVersion to Auto, then track progress with the AutoVersionStatus field in GetJob. Use StartJobUpgradeAnalysis to approve or decline an upgrade, GetJobUpgradeAnalysis to view details, and StopJobUpgradeAnalysis to stop it.
  • LambdaMicrovms (4.0.102.0)
    • AWS Lambda MicroVMs now support the x86-64 CPU architecture, which you can select in addition to ARM64 (Graviton) when launching a MicroVM.
  • QConnect (4.0.103.0)
    • Adds support for real-time agent assistance and self-service with Amazon Connect Global Resiliency, including cross-Region replication of supported AI agent resources and configurations.
  • QuickSight (4.0.113.0)
    • Amazon QuickSight adds APIs to view account service role settings and switch to or replace a customer-managed IAM role.
  • Route53Domains (4.0.102.0)
    • Route 53 Domains now supports restoring domains. This release adds the RestoreDomain API to self-serve domain restoration.
  • SageMaker (4.0.125.0)
    • Fixed the ImageDeleted and ImageVersionDeleted waiters to succeed on the ResourceNotFound error returned by DescribeImage and DescribeImageVersion
  • SecurityAgent (4.0.115.0)
    • Adds support for IAM Identity Center groups as Agent Space members. CreateMembership, DeleteMembership, and ListMemberships now accept the GROUP member type. ListMemberships can filter by USER, GROUP, or ALL, and returns group display name and description.
  • WAFV2 (4.0.103.0)
    • AWS WAF customers who monetize AI traffic on Web ACLs can now configure payments through connected accounts (Stripe).
  • Core 4.0.102.18
    • Documented that LogMetrics output includes the signed request and LogResponses output includes the raw response body.
    • EC2InstanceMetadata returns null instead of sending a request when an absolute path is not on the configured metadata service endpoint.
    • On Linux and macOS, the shared credentials and config files and the SSO and login token cache files are created with owner-only permissions in the create call instead of being created and then restricted.
    • Writes to the shared credentials and config files are rejected when a section name, property name or value contains a line break, or when a property name would not read back as the same property.
    • All service and extension packages updated to require new Core

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-05
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.Monitor.Workspaces_1.1.0-beta.1

1.1.0-beta.1 (2026-11-03)

Features Added

  • Added support for managing metric namespaces and metric configurations in Azure Monitor Workspaces.
  • Added support for managing trace containers in Azure Monitor Workspaces and trace associations at resource, resource group, and subscription scopes.

Azure.AI.AgentServer.Activity_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-11-04)

Features Added

  • Initial release of Azure.AI.AgentServer.Activity — a .NET library for hosting a Microsoft 365
    Agents SDK AgentApplication as an Azure AI Foundry hosted agent that speaks the activity
    protocol     (POST /activity/messages).
  • ActivityServer.Run(...) one-liner startup that wires Kestrel, health probes, OpenTelemetry, and
    the activity endpoint, with overloads for the way your agent is constructed:
    • Run<TAgent>() — host an AgentApplication subclass by type.
    • Run(app => ...) — register handlers inline on the built AgentApplication (no agent class).
    • Run(agentApp) — host a pre-built AgentApplication instance.
    • Run(Func<IServiceProvider, AgentApplication>) — factory registration with access to DI.
    • Run(RequestDelegate) — own the raw request pipeline (the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK is not
      initialized).
  • Composition on the shared Core host builder via AgentHostBuilder.AddActivity<TAgent>(),
    AddActivity(agentApp), and AddActivity(Func<IServiceProvider, AgentApplication>).
  • Self-hosting on your own WebApplication via AddFoundryActivity() / MapFoundryActivity()
    (aliased as AddActivityServer() / MapActivityServer()), including a RequestDelegate overload
    of MapFoundryActivity for owning the request pipeline in a self-hosted app. This is also the
    two-line conversion path for an existing Microsoft 365 Agents SDK application.
  • ActivityServerOptions for configuring the built stack: outbound-auth model (DigitalWorker),
    turn-state Storage, the outbound Connections provider, the Connections:*
    ConnectionConfiguration mapping, and a ConfigureServices hook.
  • Foundry outbound-auth is configuration-driven: ActivityEnvironment derives the M365
    Connections:* settings from the Foundry-native identity (managed identity for the simple
    agent-instance model, IdentityProxyManager for the digital worker blueprint + FMI exchange
    model) and the SDK-native connection provider mints the outbound reply token. No process
    environment is mutated.
  • Session resolution (agent_session_id query / x-agent-session-id header / environment /
    generated), sanitized session-id response header, x-platform-error-source error classification
    (user / platform / upstream), and distributed tracing via ActivityProtocolActivitySource.

Azure.AI.AgentServer.Core_1.0.0-beta.31

1.0.0-beta.31 (2026-11-04)

Features Added

  • Added the microsoft.foundry = "True" string attribute to all collected spans and log records. The default telemetry processors override conflicting marker values without changing gen_ai.provider.name.
  • Added protocol-scoped task access for composed hosts and per-task activation
    checks, stamping the owning protocol on new task records so a disabled
    protocol cannot start or recover its tasks merely because another protocol
    enabled the shared runtime. Legacy unmarked application tasks require the
    explicit Core switch for recovery; existing Invocations chains continue under
    that opt-in. The new public protocol-scoping helpers and per-task activation
    option are experimental (AAAS003).

Bugs Fixed

  • Prevented a stale steering nudge from canceling a promoted turn after its pending-input queue has drained. Pending-input publication now follows the same turn as the cancellation signal.

Azure.ResourceManager.ComputeFleet_1.1.0-beta.4

1.1.0-beta.4 (2026-11-03)

Breaking Changes

  • Removed the ZoneAllocationPolicy property from ComputeFleetProperties and the corresponding zoneAllocationPolicy parameter from ArmComputeFleetModelFactory.ComputeFleetProperties.
  • Removed ComputeFleetZoneAllocationPolicy, ComputeFleetZoneDistributionStrategy, and ZonePreference, along with the ArmComputeFleetModelFactory.ComputeFleetZoneAllocationPolicy and ArmComputeFleetModelFactory.ZonePreference methods.

System.ClientModel_1.17.0

1.17.0 (2026-11-04)

Features Added

  • Added ClientPipeline.Send and SendAsync overloads accepting a CancellationToken to override cancellation for a send while preserving applied request options.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed invalid JSON when JsonPatch replaces string-like values inside stored JSON objects or arrays.

entry.title: open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet-contrib - Releases - 2026-11-05
entry.content:
Instrumentation.Http-1.20.2

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Http v1.20.2

    • Updated Semantic Conventions version to 1.45.0.
      (#5833)

    • Fixed an issue on .NET Framework where an asynchronous HttpWebRequest
      (including HttpClient) that waited for a free connection could be sent with
      the trace context and baggage of another request.
      (#5873)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.Hangfire-1.20.2-beta.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Hangfire v1.20.2-beta.1

    • Fixed failed jobs exporting the exception message as the span status description.
      The message is now only recorded when RecordException is enabled.
      (#5884)

    • Fixed baggage from a job being visible to work started by other jobs
      performed on the same worker.
      (#5886)

    • Added EnrichWithBackgroundJob and CustomStateMappings to
      HangfireMetricsInstrumentationOptions. Use them to add custom attributes to
      the metrics and to count jobs in custom Hangfire states.
      (#5810)

    • Fixed workflow.execution.duration for the executing state. It included the
      time of other measurements of this instrumentation, for example the database
      query that RecordQueueLatency adds.
      (#5810)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

OpAmp.Client-0.10.0-alpha.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.OpAmp.Client v0.10.0-alpha.1

    • Fixed OpAmpClient.FlushAsync() potentially waiting indefinitely when new
      messages kept being queued. Messages queued after a flush starts no longer
      delay its completion.
      (#5882)

    • Fixed the pending message byte limit not counting state reports queued together
      with custom messages, which allowed pending frames to retain more memory than
      the configured limit.
      (#5881)

    • Breaking change: Renamed OpAmpClientSettings.MaxPendingCustomMessageBytes
      to MaxPendingMessageBytes to reflect that the limit also counts state reports
      queued with custom messages.
      (#5881)

    • Fix WebSocket transport startup blocking when the server sends messages
      immediately after the handshake.
      (#5883)

    • Breaking Change: The default HTTP client and the default WebSocket
      client no longer follow HTTP redirects. A redirect response now fails the
      request or connection instead of being followed. To restore redirects, set
      the new OpAmpClientSettings.AllowRedirects to true; it does not apply to
      clients returned by HttpClientFactory or ClientWebSocketFactory.
      WebSocket redirects cannot be disabled on .NET Framework and
      .NET Standard 2.0 targets.
      (#5885)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Resources.Azure-1.20.2-beta.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Resources.Azure v1.20.2-beta.1

    • Updated Semantic Conventions version to 1.45.0.
      (#5833)

    • The Azure VM resource detector no longer follows HTTP redirects returned by
      the Azure Instance Metadata Service endpoint. A redirect response is now
      treated as a failed detection.
      (#5843)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Sampler.AWS-0.1.0-alpha.18

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Sampler.AWS v0.1.0-alpha.18

    • Fixed the attributes of a sampling rule being matched incorrectly when a span
      has more than one tag with the same key.
      (#5824)

    • The sampling endpoint client no longer follows HTTP redirects or retains
      cookies. A redirect response is now treated as a failed poll, so deployments
      that rely on a redirect in front of the sampling endpoint must configure the
      final URL via SetEndpoint.
      (#5856)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Resources.AWS-1.20.2

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Resources.AWS v1.20.2

    • AWSEC2Detector, AWSECSDetector and AWSEKSDetector no longer follow HTTP
      redirects when requesting metadata. A redirect response is now treated as a
      failed request.
      (#5878)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.Owin-1.20.2-beta.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Owin v1.20.2-beta.1

    • Updated Semantic Conventions version to 1.45.0.
      (#5833)

    • Breaking Change: The http.server.request.duration metric no longer
      includes the http.request.method_original tag, and records only the
      normalized http.request.method.
      (#5880)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.ConfluentKafka-0.5.0-alpha.1

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.ConfluentKafka v0.5.0-alpha.1

    • Breaking change: Updated the traces and metrics emitted by the Kafka
      producer and consumer to follow the
      v1.45.0 messaging semantic conventions.
      The following attributes were renamed:

      • messaging.system.name (replacing messaging.system), on both spans and
        metrics
      • kafka.offset (replacing messaging.kafka.offset)
      • kafka.message.key (replacing messaging.kafka.message.key)
      • kafka.message.tombstone (replacing messaging.kafka.message.tombstone)
      • kafka.cluster.id (replacing messaging.kafka.cluster.id)

      (#5831)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.GrpcCore-1.0.0-beta.19

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.GrpcCore v1.0.0-beta.19

    • Fixed unbounded memory growth on streaming calls when RecordMessageEvents
      is enabled. At most 128 message events are now recorded per call.
      (#5879)

    • Fixed ServerTracingInterceptor applying the baggage received with one RPC
      to other RPCs.
      (#5874)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

Instrumentation.AspNet-1.20.3

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.AspNet v1.20.3

    • Updated Semantic Conventions version to 1.45.0.
      (#5833)

    • Fixed http.route and the span name containing the controller and action
      values from the request URL for conventional MVC and WebAPI routes. The names
      are now only used once a request for them has completed successfully, otherwise
      the {controller} and {action} tokens of the route template are reported.
      (#5858)

    See CHANGELOG for details.

  • NuGet: OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.AspNet.TelemetryHttpModule v1.20.3

    • Fixed baggage and an unstopped Activity being left behind when an
      EndRequest handler that runs after TelemetryHttpModule throws.
      (#5868)

    See CHANGELOG for details.
